name: Tyr
text: Tyr is a sometime anglicization of the Irish word Tir, meaning land. The element appears in names such as Tyrone. It has no link with the Norse god who shares the spelling. The record of the word element sits under the Tir head. Tyrone keeps the element at its front. English forms of the name open with this prefix.

attributes.attribute: anglicized prefix from the Irish word for land
distinct from the Norse god of the same spelling
